title: changenote configuration
description: Packages managed by changenote. Paths and version files are also checked by the CLI.

$schema.description: Schema reference for editors. The CLI does not fetch or validate this reference.

fixed.description: Disjoint groups of at least two known packages that release at one version. Membership is also checked by the CLI.

changelog.description: Optional ordered sections. Without this setting, notes are grouped by SemVer bump.

title.description: Nonempty trimmed heading without control characters or an initial SemVer version. Titles must be unique; Other Changes is reserved. The CLI checks these rules.

types.description: Note types assigned to this section. A type can occur only once across all sections; the CLI checks this rule.

path.description: Package directory relative to the repository root. Parent components are not allowed.

version_file.description: Version file relative to the package directory. Use VERSION, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, or package.json. Parent components are not allowed.
